task.name: pbj
task.description: Peanut butter and jelly sandwich, after Hayhoe, Shrivastava, Mruczek & Pelz (2003, JoV) and Land & Hayhoe (2001). Shared by the browser task (src/task) and the Python analysis (analysis/sandwich).

instructions.standard: Make a peanut butter and jelly sandwich on the plate. When you are finished, ring the bell.
instructions.tidy: Make a peanut butter and jelly sandwich on the plate. Close the jars and the bread bag when you are done, then ring the bell.
instructions.cut: Make a peanut butter and jelly sandwich on the plate and cut it in half. When you are finished, ring the bell.

action_costs_s._comment: Fixed time costs used by the planner (analysis/sandwich/planner.py) on top of Fitts-like reach time.

events.instruction: Make a peanut butter and jelly sandwich on the plate. When you are finished, ring the bell.
